newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer vs dollar.

text.p: High call rates helped the Bangladesh taka recover from an early fall to close firmer at 43.7500/7550 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday, dealers said.
This compares with a previous close at 43.7500/7600.

The local unit was quoted weaker at 43.7500/7700 per dollar in early trade but recovered later as call money rates remained high for a second straight session. Dealers said there were few deals in foreign currency and the market was focused on local currency trade.
Call money was traded at previous session's level of 13 to 15 percent.
